summary: Verified the newly-added Seller intake hard-block (mirrors Buyer form) end-to-end. All 4 scenarios PASS: (1) Seller valid submit with currently_listed=false lands on Thank-you page; (2) Ticking [data-testid='seller-currently-listed'] reveals the amber warning block containing 'Doug isn't able to help you directly' plus Communities & Glossary links, and [data-testid='seller-submit'] becomes disabled (opacity=0.5, cursor=not-allowed); (3) Buyer regression (working_with_realtor) still hard-blocks; (4) Backend POST /api/leads/seller returns HTTP 400 with detail containing 'currently listed with another REALTOR' when currently_listed=true, and 200 with success:true when false.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is still ~1400+ lines — refactor into pages/components/forms/legal modules for maintainability (carried over from iteration_5-7).

Seller form form-fields use bare <label>Text</label><input/> siblings without id/for association or wrapping label — this breaks Playwright get_by_label() and screen-reader label linking. Consider adding htmlFor + id (or wrap the input inside the label) for accessibility and testability. Non-blocking, but tests had to fall back to positional selectors.
BCFSA licence number is still literal placeholder '[Doug to add]' at data-testid=licence-num — must be filled before production launch to satisfy BCFSA advertising rules.

Backend endpoints /api/leads/buyer and /api/leads/seller silently accept unknown Pydantic fields (default). Not a bug, but consider `model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')` on lead models to catch payload drift early.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_-prefixed seller lead + one TEST_ buyer lead created in MongoDB via UI/API (safe to leave; identifiable by TEST_ prefix and testseller_*/testbuyer_* email).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seller hard-block matches Buyer hard-block behaviour on both UX layer (amber warning + disabled submit) and API layer (HTTP 400 with 'currently listed with another REALTOR®' detail). Regression on buyer flow (working_with_realtor) still works. Pytest lives at /app/backend/tests/test_seller_hardblock.py and can be re-run as a regression via `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_seller_hardblock.py -v`. Frontend labels are NOT associated to inputs via for/id — future tests should use `.field:has(> label:text-is("Label *")) input/select` selectors or add testids on each field.
rca_of_the_issue: n/a — feature verification, not a bug. Implementation mirrors iteration_5 buyer form (App.js lines 484-513 for UI, server.py lines 320-328 for backend rejection).
